records.text: Mitch Snow claims he encountered what appeared to be the end of a military briefing before a mission at a borrowed Joint Task Force–Southern Border building.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Despite the undue harassment that he received, in particular, after seeing Erika (Erika Kirk) on the evening of the 8th, he claims that he stumbled upon what appeared to him to be the conclusion of a military briefing right before a mission taking place in a borrowed building site for the Joint Task Force, ... the Southern Border Unit.

verification.notes: This statement accurately paraphrases the encounter Snow says he had; his later interview repeats the claimed lobby/briefing sequence. USNORTHCOM confirms that Joint Task Force-Southern Border was activated at Fort Huachuca in 2025, but neither that official record nor any independent evidence verifies Snow's claimed encounter or interpretation.

sources.title: USNORTHCOM: Joint Task Force-Southern Border established
sources.relevance: Official confirmation of the task force and its Fort Huachuca headquarters, not of Snow's encounter.

records.text: Owens said Fort Huachuca personnel began what became a seven-hour interrogation of Harry Myers after someone hit a panic button at the headquarters.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Suddenly somebody hits the panic button and two captains come out and they escort him out of the building and they begin what becomes a seven-hour interrogation, okay?

verification.notes: No public incident report, base record, witness account, or authenticated contemporaneous document was found to corroborate the duration or reason for the alleged questioning. The speaker and conveyance now reflect that Owens relayed Myers account rather than witnessed the event.

records.text: Anonymous correspondents currently stationed at Fort Huachuca told Owens that Joint Task Force–Southern Border was using a borrowed, effectively unmarked building converted into a SCIF with barbed wire and restrictions on personal electronics
records.speaker: Fort Huachuca stationed correspondents (identities unverified)

appearances.snippet: Well, guess what? We have confirmed from people currently stationed on the base. ... that JTF is indeed using a building and not going to name the building I know the exact one, because I don't want to accidentally violate national security, but effectively they are borrowing a building so it's effectively unmarked in that sense, and that that building has been turned into ... Please forgive me if I get this wrong, but I'm reading it direct from the email, SCIF, which stands for a Sensitive Compartmented Information Facility, okay? ... So they have since added barbed wire around that facility for additional security. Cell phones and other electronics are not allowed.

verification.notes: Verification attempted. USNORTHCOM confirms JTF–Southern Border headquarters infrastructure at Fort Huachuca, but no authoritative public source located confirms the alleged borrowed/unmarked building, SCIF conversion, barbed wire, or device rules. The episode attributes those details to unnamed correspondents, so the specific allegation remains unverifiable.

sources.title: New joint task force established to lead USNORTHCOM efforts on southern border
sources.relevance: Officially confirms JTF–Southern Border was activated at Fort Huachuca and that the 10th Mountain Division established its headquarters infrastructure; it does not confirm the alleged building or SCIF details.

conveyance.original_source: Emails from people stationed at Fort Huachuca

records.text: Owens reported that Myers characterized the Fort Huachuca gathering as the kind of senior-officer meeting held ahead of an operation, while Owens said she did not know what to make of his information.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: These are the meetings that are had ahead of an operation. Like when an operation is being confirmed, you have these final meetings and they involve all of the higher ups and you are trying to do this in a very isolated location where people are not gonna accidentally happen upon you because they've got something to say about what happened 35 years ago And that is what he happened upon. ... And I don't know what to make of his information other than he feels that he then recognized these people.

verification.notes: The transcript confirms Owens attributed to Myers his interpretation that the Fort Huachuca gathering resembled a senior-officer pre-operation meeting, while she expressed uncertainty about what to make of it. Current searches found no agenda, attendee list, official release, authenticated incident report, or independent witness that establishes the gathering's purpose. Episode mirrors repeat Myers' characterization but are not independent evidence of what the meeting was. The interpretation remains unverifiable.

records.text: Owens reported that Myers estimated 12 to 13 lieutenant colonels were at the meeting he encountered.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: He estimates that there were 12 to 13 lieutenant colonels that were in that meeting that he stumbled upon.

verification.notes: Transcript context confirms Owens reported Myers' estimate of 12 to 13 lieutenant colonels. Current searches of Fort Huachuca and Army public material, the date, the alleged meeting, and Myers' account found no attendee list, official schedule, access record, or independent witness confirming either the number or ranks. Public summaries trace back to Owens' episode. The estimate is neither confirmed nor directly contradicted and remains unverifiable.

records.text: Mitch Snow formerly member of Joint Task Force–Southern Border

appearances.snippet: Mitch (Mitch Snow) was certain. He was certain. And I want to be clear, he also hasn't moved his story since, not one inch. He was certain that he saw Erika Kirk on the evening of the 8th at Fort Huachuca leaving a hotel with a Cabot Phillips lookalike. He has not adopted, he has not adapted that story. He has not adapted that story. Despite the undue harassment that he received, in particular, after seeing Erika (Erika Kirk) on the evening of the 8th, he claims that he stumbled upon what appeared to him to be the conclusion of a military briefing right before a mission taking place in a borrowed building site for the Joint Task Force, the Southern Border Unit. And he was a border unit and he was surprised he saw a guy. Running the JTF thing, I think he said it was JTF 10, the 10th Mountain Brigade. He's like, oh, where are you guys? I thought this was like disbanded. I used to be on this same task force, Southern Border.
